description: Trim edits in the Timeline, each one undo step. slip: move the source in and out points of clips by the same amount, so they show other frames in the same place (Slip tool, Slip Clip Selection). roll: move the edit point between a clip and the next clip on its track (Rolling Edit tool; on an audio clip alone this makes a J or L cut). slide: move a clip between its neighbours, which are trimmed to keep the gap closed (Slide tool). trim_start_to_playhead and trim_end_to_playhead: trim clips under the playhead to it without rippling (Trim Previous and Trim Next Edit to Playhead)

by.description: slip, roll and slide: seconds; negative is earlier (slip: shows earlier frames)

clips.description: Clips (items from list_clips, or selected: true). roll and slide take one clip. The trims default to every clip under the playhead

items.description: A clip in the sequence, as list_clips reports it

clipIndex.description: Clip index on the track, 0 = first

selected.description: Include the clips selected in the Timeline

frames.description: Instead of by: frames of the sequence (Slip Clip Selection uses 1 or 5)

sequence.description: Which sequence. Give its name or guid (from list_sequences); omit for the active sequence

name: edit_clips
title: Edit Clips
